tasks.brief:
Path: src/services/storage.py
Constraints: Sync-only; use `threading.Lock`; no async; `shutil`, `json`, `os`, `pathlib` allowed. Do not modify `load_snapshot` or `save_snapshot` signatures.
Behavior: Add `SnapshotConflict` exception class with `current_revision` attribute. Add `load_versioned_snapshot()` returning `(threads, revision)`. Handle legacy raw list (no revision key) as revision 0. Add `save_versioned_snapshot(threads, expected_revision)` returning new revision. Implement `_save_versioned_snapshot_locked` for atomic write: compare revision, raise `SnapshotConflict` on mismatch. On match, rotate primary to `.bak` (warn on failure but re-raise original), write temp, atomic replace. Handle cleanup failure by re-raising original error. Update `save_snapshot` to use versioned logic internally.
Acceptance: `load_versioned_snapshot` returns correct tuple; `save_versioned_snapshot` advances revision and rotates backup; `SnapshotConflict` raised on mismatch; legacy files read as rev 0; error handling preserves original exceptions.

Path: src/api/threads.py
Constraints: FastAPI; use `Pydantic` models; no direct DB access; import `SnapshotConflict` from storage. Do not change other routes.
Behavior: Extend `ThreadsPayload` with required `revision: int >= 0`. Add DELETE body model with `revision`. Update GET `/api/v1/threads` to call `load_versioned_snapshot` and return `{threads, revision, quarantined}`. Update PUT to call `save_versioned_snapshot` with payload threads/revision, return `{status: ok, revision: new_rev}`. Update DELETE to call `save_versioned_snapshot` with empty list/revision. Map `SnapshotConflict` to HTTP 409 with `{error: revision_conflict, current_revision: n}`. Validation errors remain 422.
Acceptance: GET returns revision/quarantined; PUT/DELETE advance revision; 409 on conflict with correct body; 422 on missing/invalid revision; no writes on validation failure.

Path: src/static/threads.js
Constraints: ES6 module pattern (IIFE or global scope); no external libs; sync DOM manipulation; async fetch for persistence. Do not touch unrelated sidebar logic.
Behavior: Add `hydratedRevision` variable. Add `persistQueue` array and `isPersisting` flag. Add `conflictLatch` boolean. Implement `enqueueSnapshot(snapshot)` to push to queue and trigger `flushQueue()`. Implement `flushQueue()` to process one item at a time: fetch PUT `/api/v1/threads` with `{threads: snapshot, revision: hydratedRevision}`. On 200, update `hydratedRevision` from response, clear queue head. On 409, set `conflictLatch = true`, clear queue, set `save-status` text to 'history changed elsewhere — reload required'. On other error, set `save-status` to 'not saved'. Expose `setHydratedRevision(n)` for app.js.
Acceptance: Queue serializes requests; revision updates on success; 409 latches UI and shows message; errors show 'not saved'; `setHydratedRevision` updates internal state.

Path: src/static/app.js
Constraints: ES6; async/await for hydration; no external libs. Do not touch chat send/stream logic.
Behavior: In startup hydration (GET `/api/v1/threads`), parse response `revision` and call `Threads.setHydratedRevision(data.revision)`. Store `data.threads` as before. On reload, reset `save-status` to empty and clear any conflict state if exposed. Ensure default thread creation enqueues a snapshot with the current hydrated revision. Never infer revision from content.
Acceptance: Hydration sets revision in threads module; reload clears status; default thread save uses correct revision; no regression in existing chat functionality.
